title: My Street
text:
I live on a small street near a park. There is a bakery on the corner. The baker is very friendly and sells fresh bread every morning.

Across the street, there is a school. Children play in the yard after lunch. My neighbor has a big dog, and it likes to play with the children.

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the neighborhood?
options: They do not know it well

questions.text: Why is the baker probably popular with people in the street?
options: He sells fresh bread and is friendly

vocabulary.definition: a shop that sells bread and cakes
the place where two streets meet
kind and pleasant to other people
a place where children go to learn

paragraph_translations: Eu moro em uma rua pequena perto de um parque. Há uma padaria na esquina. O padeiro é muito simpático e vende pão fresco todas as manhãs.
Do outro lado da rua, há uma escola. As crianças brincam no pátio depois do almoço. Meu vizinho tem um cachorro grande, e ele gosta de brincar com as crianças.
